format: Moraff's Revenge statically recovered input and timing schema v1
evidence: Recovered solely from 16-bit QuickBASIC 3 code and BRUN30 runtime handlers; DOSBox was not used.

first_byte_helper.actual_operation: return first byte of nonempty string descriptor in BL
first_byte_helper.evidence: BRUN30 9BC2-9BD5 dereferences descriptor data twice and loads one byte; call sites compare with ASCII 13, 27, 96 and 122

sound_prompt.rng_boundary: 0514 calls B9B3 first: one RND selects INT(RND*6) from the startup text-color table

loading_review.rng_boundary: BA15 consumes one RND for the default text color, then BA1E consumes another for INT(RND*6)+1 review selection
loading_review.leading_color_digit: 1 through 7 is removed and sets text color
loading_review.loading_notice: SCREEN 0 row 25 prints Please read this... and starts T135MNO3L4CD+F.L8D+DCD.D+16C4L4G>C while resources/character load
loading_review.acknowledgement: after character load, SCREEN 1 prints HIT ANY KEY and waits for one nonempty key
loading_review.final_boundary: restore SCREEN 1 and drain 18 INKEY$ polls at 059A

mode_toggle.operation: increment; when value becomes 2, replace with 0

relative_mode_zero.up: move one cell in current facing

successful_step.condition: only after destination monster and wall tests allow movement

commands.D: descend through a positive vertical feature; at the level-70 fountain cell, drink from the fountain instead
commands.Q: save and chain to BEGIN character selection
commands.U: show/use rope when applicable; ascend through a negative vertical feature
commands.A: offer to drop all carried treasure
commands.P: pause; Q from the pause prompt saves and exits to DOS
commands.O: toggle sound and show SOUND ON/OFF for two seconds

not_a_main_command.F: F is handled inside combat at 8864; it is not dispatched by the exploration command table

main_command_dispatch.pause_response_case: the P command itself is normalized by the main/combat dispatcher, but 8019 reads the response through raw 2F71 and accepts uppercase Q only

commands.P: pause using the shared 7FFB pause/Q-for-DOS routine
commands.B: breathe fire while the persisted effect-expiry timer at DS:1BC2 remains active

combat_command_dispatch.movement: combat first calls the ordinary exploration command/movement path at 871F. If movement separates player and monster, combat exits through 8E76; combat therefore does not lock out movement.

spells.level_input: one INKEY$ character converted by VAL; valid range 1..6
spells.point_gate: selected level must not exceed current spell points
spells.choice_input: 1 or 2 selects a nonblank learned name; 3 cancels; Escape is rewritten to 3; selecting a blank entry also cancels
spells.preparation_entry_drain: 3590 performs the fixed 18-poll drain; the battle entry has no corresponding drain

statistics_redirects: Feather when it does not fall through
preparation_presentation.sense_level: prints YOU ARE ON LEVEL <n> and reads one nonempty raw key
preparation_presentation.sense_location: prints X/Y and level on two lines and waits four TIMER seconds
preparation_presentation.ascend_transition: prints POOF without a deliberate result wait
preparation_presentation.silent_results: duplicate effects plus Descend, Change Level, Invisibility, Heal, and Mocciolo outcomes 2 through 4 have no invented result message

choices.5: bag of holding when status bit 2 is set
choices.6: floor slosher when status bit 64 is set

preparation_items.unavailable_display: the number remains visible but the item name is blank
preparation_items.ordinary_return: one raw key is read; nonnumeric, out-of-range, and unavailable choices return immediately to the main loop, so Escape/L also leave through VAL(key)=0 without a displayed leave line
preparation_items.guild_information_mode: invalid or unavailable choices repeat; uppercase L leaves

floor_slosher.success: clears, prints YOU ARE SLIPPING THROUGH THE FLOOR., waits for one nonempty raw key, then changes floors

battle_items.unavailable_display: the number remains visible but the item name is blank
battle_items.ordinary_return: one raw key is read; nonnumeric, out-of-range, and unavailable choices return immediately to the combat loop
battle_items.guild_information_mode: invalid or unavailable choices repeat; L or l leaves

help.files: H1.OVL through H8.OVL opened as sequential text
help.record_marker: a leading tilde is removed and routes the record through the colored help renderer
help.chapter_dispatch: H1 is the index; numeric choices chain to the matching chapter; H8 is combat help

held_key_repeat.behavior: main loop polls INKEY$ once per pass; repeated held input is supplied by DOS BIOS keyboard typematic events
held_key_repeat.configured_delay_acceleration: draw_status_and_map applies the configured busy-loop delay only when the current explored bit is nonzero and DS:B5FA is at most 3; an arrow string increments B5FA and other input resets it, so the fifth consecutive typematic arrow and later repeats bypass that delay

idle_monster_update.calibration: wait for a fresh TIMER tick, count tight-loop iterations for one second, then divide the count by 326
idle_monster_update.trigger: INT(RND*interval)=1 calls 7001, which advances and wraps the floor-global monster cursor and calls the pursuit routine only for an odd global record
idle_monster_update.important_boundary: runs in all three recovered polling controllers: exploration 08F3, combat 86E2, and shared modal reader 7DC9. The modal reader is used by spell levels/choices, wands, pills, battle items, drop treasure, defeat Return, and coin loot. Each 7DC9 entry calls 7EEC even if INKEY$ already returned a key. Level zero returns inside 7001 only after the 7EEC gate RND was consumed.
idle_monster_update.native_mapping: mr_session_idle_monster_poll plus mr_read_dos_key_with_idle_monsters and mr_read_modal_key_with_idle_monsters; 326 normalized polls/second with speed_calibration=1 is algebraically equivalent to BF60's loops_per_second/326 calibration

keyboard_drain.behavior: fixed-count INKEY$ drain/debounce, not a wait-until-release loop
keyboard_drain.complete_key_semantics: a zero-prefixed extended key is one two-byte INKEY$ string and therefore consumes one poll

menu_reentry_drains.store: 281E is traversed on every recoverable store-menu restart
menu_reentry_drains.wizard_guild: 2BB8-2BBE clears and drains on every outer guild-menu restart

command_cycle_status.rings_of_health: restore the stored ring count up to maximum HP on each status/redraw cycle
command_cycle_status.disease: increment a positive counter; each exact multiple of 100 consumes INT(RND*6), drains that attribute by one, waits four seconds, and clamps all six attributes to at least one
command_cycle_status.warning: You feel sick. You need a cure disease.

fountain.prompt: 3D83 drains 18 polls, then overlays the two-line fountain prompt every command pass
fountain.drink: 3DAE clears and prints YOU FEEL STRANGE...; 3DC0 waits four seconds before the restart transition

two_second_paths: 9555 Speed, Strength, Heal, or God outcome 5
battle_spell_result.gas_success_prefix: IT FALLS ASLEEP AND YOU KILL IT
battle_spell_result.wand_reentry: yellow, green, and red wands enter Strength, Lightning, and Explosion respectively at 8926-896A and inherit the same result timing

too_heavy_branch.text: IT'S TOO HEAVY FOR YOU TO CARRY

post_combat_sequence.spellbook_weapon_wand_pill_acknowledgeme: 2F3C prints Hit any key and reads one nonempty key

attribute_book.first_text: Press any key to read it.

configured_delay.consumer: 4127-4169 empty floating-point-counted loop in the monster/view update path
